verdict.rationale: Polar documents signed webhook deliveries following the Standard Webhooks spec (older secrets use Polar HMAC). Its SDKs include built-in signature validation and typed payloads, and the docs mention delivery monitoring, which roughly covers event logs. They also document a `polar listen` local forwarding tool and a Customer State webhook event. The evidence never mentions automatic webhook retries or replay; the documented retry schedule is for failed subscription charges (dunning), not webhook deliveries. Missing for 10: documented automatic webhook delivery retries, event replay/redelivery, detailed event-log documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
